Definition: Cheldai, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Heldai names two men of the return. One is the Netophathite captain of the twelfth course, of Othniel, with twenty-four thousand in his course, and the other is one of the captives come from Babylon who brings gold for the crown of Joshua.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Heldais show the same name serving in the army and in the temple: a captain under David and a giver under Zerubbabel, both counted by God.
